pairs.target: xiàkèhòu , tǎ wéi bǎ juǎn hǎo de zhǐ cóng bìwān huàn dào lìngyìbiān , tuīkāi jiù suǒ fáng hòumiàn de mén .
pairs.english: After class, Tavi shifted the rolled papers to his other arm and pushed open the door behind the old cable house.
pairs.hanzi: 下课后，塔维把卷好的纸从臂弯换到另一边，推开旧索房后面的门。

pairs.target: nài lěi zhù de wūlǐ duō le yìtiáo shài zhe de bǎngtuǐ , chuāng xià tānzhe dìtú , zhuō jiǎo hái yā zhe zuówǎn nà zhī bēizi .
pairs.english: A leg wrap now hung drying in Nerai’s room; maps lay spread beneath the window, and last night’s cup still weighted a corner of the table.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾住的屋里多了一条晒着的绑腿，窗下摊着地图，桌角还压着昨晚那只杯子。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā bǎmén liútiáo fèng , shuō xié gāng shuā guò , guānyán le wūlǐ biàn quán shì héní wèi .
pairs.english: She asked him to leave a gap in the door, saying her shoes had just been scrubbed; shutting it tight would make the whole room smell of river mud.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他把门留条缝，说鞋刚刷过，关严了屋里便全是河泥味。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yīyán zuòxià , zhǎnkāi zìjǐ dàilái de tú , zuì shàngmiàn shì xuégōng dào hòuchē péng de lùxiàn , dǐxià shì qúkǒu nà zhāng liúgěi tā de cǎogǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi sat down as asked and opened the drawings he had brought: the route from the academy to the waiting shelter on top, and the canal draft he had been allowed to keep underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维依言坐下，展开自己带来的图，最上面是学宫到候车棚的路线，底下是渠口那张留给他的草稿。

alignment.english: he had been allowed to keep

pairs.target: tā méi dài mǐlā de tú , yě méiyǒu línshí huà yìtiáo zìjǐ méi zǒuguò de yuǎnlù .
pairs.english: He had not brought Mira’s drawing or hastily sketched a distant route he had never walked.
pairs.hanzi: 他没带米拉的图，也没有临时画一条自己没走过的远路。

pairs.target: nài lěi què xiān ná qǐ hòuchē péng nà zhāng , wèn huà dào zhègēn quēkǒu zhùzi shí , tā zhàn zài nǎlǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai picked up the shelter drawing first, though, and asked where he had stood when he drew the chipped post.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾却先拿起候车棚那张，问画到这根缺口柱子时，他站在哪里。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ le gè wèizhì , yòu shuō hòulái de zhíbānrén bìng bú zhàn zài nàlǐ , nà shì zìjǐ dìyīcì qù shí jì de .
pairs.english: He pointed to a spot, adding that the later attendant had not stood there: he had marked it on his first visit.
pairs.hanzi: 他指了个位置，又说后来的值班人并不站在那里，那是自己第一次去时记的。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ zhuǎn le bànquān , cháo ménkǒu mī yǎnkàn le yíxià , wèn tuīchē de rén guòlái néng bunéng kànjiàn .
pairs.english: She turned the paper halfway round and squinted toward the doorway, then asked whether an approaching cart-pusher could see it.
pairs.hanzi: 她把纸转了半圈，朝门口眯眼看了一下，问推车的人过来能不能看见。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , shuō kànbújiàn , hòulái yǔtiān zài kàn , lián yuánxiān huà lái děng rén de dìfāng dōu dīshuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and said no; looking again later in the rain, he found that even the spot originally drawn for waiting also dripped water.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，说看不见，后来雨天再看，连原先画来等人的地方都滴水。

pairs.target: " zhè zhāng wǒ děi liú zhe , miǎnde nǐ zhǐ kěn gěi wǒ kàn hǎokàn de . "
pairs.english: “I must keep this one, so you don't show me only the pretty ones.”
pairs.hanzi: “这张我得留着，免得你只肯给我看好看的。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán cái wèn néng bunéng jiè , tā shuō kěyǐ , búguò yào huán , biānshàng yǒu tā hòu tiān de jìhào .
pairs.english: Only after saying it did she ask to borrow it; he said yes, but she must return it, since he had added marks along the edge.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完才问能不能借，他说可以，不过要还，边上有他后添的记号。

pairs.target: nài lěi biàn zài zhuōbiān gěi tā liú le kuài gān dìfāng , méiyǒu wǎng zìjǐ de jiù tú xiàmiàn yì sāi .
pairs.english: Nerai therefore cleared a dry spot for it beside the table instead of stuffing it into the space beneath her old map.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾便在桌边给它留了块干地方，没有往自己的旧图下面一塞。

pairs.target: tā nà zhāng tú bǐ zhuōzi hái kuān , yòubiān chuíxiàlái , xì lánxiàn yìzhí zuàn dào zhuō dǐ .
pairs.english: Her map was wider than the table; its right side hung down, and a thin blue line ran all the way under the table.
pairs.hanzi: 她那张图比桌子还宽，右边垂下来，细蓝线一直钻到桌底。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu xiǎng bǎ tā tuōzhù , nài lěi jiào tā xiān biéjí , zìjǐ náchū yì jié mùbǎn , dā zài liǎngzhāng dèngzi zhījiān .
pairs.english: Tavi reached out to support it; Nerai told him not to rush, then took out a short board and laid it across two stools herself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手想把它托住，奈蕾叫他先别急，自己拿出一截木板，搭在两张凳子之间。

pairs.target: zhǐ mànmàn pūpíng , shānlù dào zhèlǐ hūrán shū le , yuánxiān jǐ zài yìqǐ de dìmíng sànkāi , hédào què yuèláiyuè duō .
pairs.english: The paper slowly flattened; here the mountain roads suddenly thinned, the once-crowded place names scattered, while the waterways grew more numerous.
pairs.hanzi: 纸慢慢铺平，山路到这里忽然疏了，原先挤在一起的地名散开，河道却越来越多。

pairs.target: chì píng bú zài tú biānshàng , guò le tā háiyǒu yí dàpiàn zhǐ , yǒu zì de dìfāng yuǎn bǐ tā xiǎng de shǎo .
pairs.english: Red Flats was not at the map's edge; a broad expanse of paper lay beyond it, with writing in far fewer places than he had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 赤坪不在图边上，过了它还有一大片纸，有字的地方远比他想的少。

pairs.target: tā mō zhe zhuō yán , méi pèng zhǐ , wèn nàxiē kōng chù shìbushì méi rén zhù .
pairs.english: Resting his fingers on the table edge without touching the paper, he asked whether nobody lived in those blank areas.
pairs.hanzi: 他摸着桌沿，没碰纸，问那些空处是不是没人住。

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō yǒuxiē méi rén zhù , yǒuxiē shì tā bù zhīdào , biétì yíkuài kòngbái bǎ huà shuō sǐ .
pairs.english: Nerai said some were uninhabited and some she knew nothing about: don't speak for a blank space and rule everything out.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说有些没人住，有些是她不知道，别替一块空白把话说死。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ gěi tā kàn yígè xiǎoxiǎode fāngkuàng , shuō nàlǐ yǒu jiān zào wū , zhǔrén kào tì chuánshàng rèfàn zhèngqián , tú shàng què kànbùchū měitiān yǒu duōshǎo zhāngzuǐ lái .
pairs.english: She showed him a tiny square, saying a cookhouse stood there: its owner earned money by heating meals for boats, though the map did not show how many mouths arrived each day.
pairs.hanzi: 她指给他看一个小小的方框，说那里有间灶屋，主人靠替船上热饭挣钱，图上却看不出每天有多少张嘴来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tāmen yèlǐ zhù nǎér , tā shuō xiān zhù chì píng de jiù kèzhàn , wǎng nán nàduàn suí chuán , búhuì měirì dōu shuì zài wūdǐng dǐxià .
pairs.english: Tavi asked where they would sleep at night; she said they would first stay at an old inn in Red Flats, then follow the boat on the southern stretch, without sleeping beneath a roof every night.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问他们夜里住哪儿，她说先住赤坪的旧客栈，往南那段随船，不会每日都睡在屋顶底下。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ kěyǐ shuì jiǎbǎn , huà gāng chūkǒu , biàn juéde xiàng zài qiǎng zhe zhèngmíng shénme .
pairs.english: He said he could sleep on deck, but as the words left his mouth he felt as if he were rushing to prove something.
pairs.hanzi: 他说自己可以睡甲板，话刚出口，便觉得像在抢着证明什么。

pairs.target: nài lěi méi jiē zhè jù , bǎ juǎn qǐlái de yìjiǎo yāzhù , gěi tā kàn yán chuán kàoàn shí de cǎotú .
pairs.english: Nerai did not respond to that; she weighted a curled corner and showed him a sketch of a salt boat coming ashore.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没接这句，把卷起来的一角压住，给他看盐船靠岸时的草图。

pairs.target: ànbiān yǒu sāngēn zhuāng , qízhōng yìgēn wāi zhe , liǎngchù jiǎoyìn pángbiān xiě le bùtóng de rìzi .
pairs.english: Three posts stood on the bank, one of them leaning; different dates appeared beside two sets of footprints.
pairs.hanzi: 岸边有三根桩，其中一根歪着，两处脚印旁边写了不同的日子。

pairs.target: tā shuō wāi zhuāng shàng kànzhe xiàng néng jìshéng , qùnián yǒurén yì lā , zhuāng dǐ lián zhe ní pí yìqǐ fān le .
pairs.english: She said the leaning post looked as if it could take a rope, but last year someone had pulled and the post base tipped over, taking the crust of mud along with it.
pairs.hanzi: 她说歪桩上看着像能系绳，去年有人一拉，桩底连着泥皮一起翻了。

pairs.target: " suǒyǐ zhèhuí shì qù huàn zhuāng ? "
pairs.english: “So is this trip to replace the post?”
pairs.hanzi: “所以这回是去换桩？”

pairs.target: " búshì , shì xiān bié bǎ tā huà chéng mǎtóu . "
pairs.english: “No, I mean: first, don’t draw it as a landing.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是，是先别把它画成码头。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zìjǐ de shǒu shōuhuí lái , hūrán yǒudiǎn míngbái , wèishénme tā yào zhǎo rén jì ànshàng de tíng chù .
pairs.english: Tavi drew his hand back, suddenly beginning to understand why she wanted someone to record stopping places on the bank.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把自己的手收回来，忽然有点明白，为什么她要找人记岸上的停处。

pairs.target: nài lěi kàn tā bù shuōhuà , biàn wèn shìbushì xián zhè huó méiyǒu xiǎng de yǒuyìsī .
pairs.english: Seeing him silent, Nerai asked whether he felt this work was not as interesting as expected.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾看他不说话，便问是不是嫌这活没有想的有意思。

pairs.target: tā yáotóu , shuō zìjǐ yǐwéi huì xiān kànjiàn hěn yuǎn de dìfāng , méixiǎngdào dào le nàlǐ , hái děi cóng jiǎoxià chóngxīn kàn .
pairs.english: He shook his head and said he had thought he would first see distant places, not that once there he would have to look afresh beneath his feet.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头，说自己以为会先看见很远的地方，没想到到了那里，还得从脚下重新看。

pairs.target: " yuǎnchù yě huì bànjiǎo . "
pairs.english: “You can trip in faraway places too.”
pairs.hanzi: “远处也会绊脚。”

pairs.target: tā shuō zhèhuà shí , zhèng yòng jiǎo bǎ wāidiào de dèngzi gōu zhèng , zìjǐ xiān xiào le .
pairs.english: As she spoke, she was hooking the crooked stool straight with her foot, and laughed first herself.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这话时，正用脚把歪掉的凳子勾正，自己先笑了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe xiào , shēnshǒu wěnzhù mùbǎn , ràng tā bǎ tú biān nà kuài zhènzhǐ yíguòlái .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed with her and reached out to steady the board while she moved over the paperweight from the map's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着笑，伸手稳住木板，让她把图边那块镇纸移过来。

pairs.target: jiēxiàlái tā bǎ yào zuò de huó shuō qīng : tā pànduàn lùxiàn , tā jì rìqī , shuǐwèi hénjì hé rénjiā shíjì yuànyì jiè de luòjiǎochù .
pairs.english: Then she explained the task: she would judge the route, while he recorded dates, water marks and places people actually agreed to let them land.
pairs.hanzi: 接下来她把要做的活说清：她判断路线，他记日期、水位痕迹和人家实际愿意借的落脚处。

pairs.target: wèn biérén zhīqián , xiān shuōmíng zhèxiē zì huì gěi shuí kàn , bùnéng bǎ yíjù kèqìhuà xiěchéng shuí dōu néng qù .
pairs.english: Before asking people, first explain who will see these words; you must not write a polite remark up as permission for anyone to go.
pairs.hanzi: 问别人之前，先说明这些字会给谁看，不能把一句客气话写成谁都能去。

pairs.target: fǎnchéng yào dàihuí xuégōng yífèn zhěnglǐ gǎo , yuánshǐjìlù liú zhe ; tú shàng de rén ruò yào kàn , yě bùnéng zhǐ shèng yìzhāng biérén tì tāmen gǎiguò de tú .
pairs.english: On their return they would bring an edited copy to the academy and keep the raw notes; if people on the map wanted to read it, they must not be left with only a map revised by others on their behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 返程要带回学宫一份整理稿，原始记录留着；图上的人若要看，也不能只剩一张别人替他们改过的图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn zhè shì shuí fùqián , nài lěi shuō jǐjiā cháng zǒu zhè duàn shuǐlù de huòzhǔ còu de , búshì guānfǔ , yě búshì yán chuán yìjiā .
pairs.english: Tavi asked who was paying for this; Nerai said several freight owners who regularly travelled that stretch had pooled the money, not the government or the salt boat alone.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问这是谁付钱，奈蕾说几家常走这段水路的货主凑的，不是官府，也不是盐船一家。

pairs.target: tāmen pàn zhe shǎo ràolù , què wèibì yuànyì fù xiūlù de qián , zhè liǎngjiànshì bié zài zhǐ shàng húchéng yíjiàn .
pairs.english: They hoped to avoid detours, but might not be willing to pay money for road repairs; the two things must not be blurred together on paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他们盼着少绕路，却未必愿意付修路的钱，这两件事别在纸上糊成一件。

pairs.target: tā zhǐ le zhǐ tā , shuō tā de lùfèi , chuánshàng chī zhù guī zhè tàng gōng lǐ , lìng yǒu jìlù de gōngqián , shùmù yào liántóng shíjì rìzi míngzǎo shuō qīng .
pairs.english: Pointing to him, she said his fares and food and lodging aboard would be covered by this job, with a separate recording fee whose amount they would clarify tomorrow morning along with the actual days.
pairs.hanzi: 她指了指他，说他的路费、船上吃住归这趟工里，另有记录的工钱，数目要连同实际日子明早说清。

pairs.target: " wǒ yuē le jiǎn lǎoshī , xiān tīng nǐ zìjǐ shuō , búyòng tì wǒ bǎ huà shuō piàoliang . "
pairs.english: “I have arranged to see Instructor Jian; let him hear you speak for yourself first, without polishing the words on my behalf.”
pairs.hanzi: “我约了简老师，先听你自己说，不用替我把话说漂亮。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying , yòu wèn néng bunéng kàn yìyǎn tā nà zhāng wāi zhuāng de cǎotú .
pairs.english: Tavi agreed, then asked whether he could look at her sketch of the leaning post.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应，又问能不能看一眼她那张歪桩的草图。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ zhǐ tuīguòlái , jiào tā zìjǐ zhǎo , nǎ yíchù búshì tā qīnyǎn jiàn de .
pairs.english: Nerai pushed it toward him, telling him to find for himself which part she had not seen with her own eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把纸推过来，叫他自己找，哪一处不是她亲眼见的。

pairs.target: tā pā jìn le xiē , xiān zhǎo rìqī , zhǎo le bàntiān , cái fāxiàn jiǎoluò xiě zhe yígè chuánjiā de míngzì .
pairs.english: He leaned closer and looked for the dates first; only after a long search did he notice a boatman's name written in the corner.
pairs.hanzi: 他趴近了些，先找日期，找了半天，才发现角落写着一个船家的名字。

pairs.target: chuāngfèng chuījìnlái yíxiàn fēng , bǎ zhuōbiān nàtiáo shài zhe de bǎngtuǐ chuī de qīngqīng pèng qiáng , xiàng yǒurén hái méi zǒu , jiù yǐ zài cuī yīfu gān .
pairs.english: A thread of wind slipped through the window gap and blew the drying leg wrap beside the table gently against the wall, as though someone were hurrying the clothes to dry before they had even left.
pairs.hanzi: 窗缝吹进来一线风，把桌边那条晒着的绑腿吹得轻轻碰墙，像有人还没走，就已在催衣服干。
